name: Apify
description: Web scraping and automation platform. Discover and run actors, retrieve results, create/edit source versions, build and debug actors, and configure Apify Store publication and pricing. Paid listings require Apify seller onboarding and Store eligibility.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Verify the Apify token and return the authenticated user's private account metadata.

tools.name: search_store_actors
tools.description: Search public Apify Store actors. Use this to discover real-estate, lead, social, search, scraping, or automation actors before running one. Prefer responseFormat='agent' for compact agent-readable results.

search.description: Search text matched against actor title, name, description, username, and README, e.g. 'real estate listings'.

limit.description: Maximum actors to return. Default and maximum are 1000.

offset.description: Number of actors to skip for pagination.

username.description: Only return actors from this Apify username.

pricingModel.description: Only return actors with this pricing model.

allowsAgenticUsers.description: When true, only return actors marked as allowing agentic users.

responseFormat.description: Use 'agent' for a reduced field set optimized for LLM consumers; default is 'full'.

includeUnrunnableActors.description: By default unrunnable actors are excluded. Set true only when you intentionally need the full store search.

tools.name: list_actors
tools.description: List actors the authenticated user created or used. Use my=true to list only actors owned by the user.

my.description: If true, only return actors owned by the authenticated user.

limit.description: Maximum actors to return. Default and maximum are 1000.

tools.name: get_actor
tools.description: Get details for a specific actor. actorId must be an Apify actor ID or a tilde-separated name like 'apify~web-scraper' or 'compass~crawler-google-places'. Do not use slash form in this API path.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. 'apify~web-scraper'.

tools.name: get_actor_openapi
tools.description: Get an actor build's OpenAPI definition, including the actor input schema when the actor exposes one. Use buildId='default' for the actor's default build. actorId must be an Apify actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. 'apify~web-scraper'.

buildId.description: Actor build ID, or 'default' to fetch the default build OpenAPI schema.

tools.name: create_actor
tools.description: Create an actor with source versions, metadata and default run options. Upload files including README and actor/input/output schemas, or use a supported repository source. Build and test before publishing. Returns the complete Actor response. Does not itself configure seller billing or payouts.

name.description: The identifier of the Actor. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Spaces or special characters aren't allowed. Must be unique across your account.

description.description: Short description of the Actor, displayed in Apify Store and Console.

isPublic.description: Whether the Actor is available to users in Apify Store. If `false`, the Actor is private and only visible to you. Prefer creating privately, testing a successful build, and then publishing with update_actor.

seoTitle.description: Name of the Actor to display by search engines such as Google. Can be different from the Actor's name displayed in Apify Store and Console. Recommended length is 40-50 characters.

seoDescription.description: Description of the Actor to display by search engines such as Google. Recommended length is 140-156 characters.

versionNumber.description: Source version as MAJOR.MINOR, e.g. 0.1. Each component is 0..99.

sourceType.description: Source location. Provide sourceFiles, gitRepoUrl, tarballUrl or gitHubGistUrl for the selected type.

name.description: The name of the environment variable.

value.description: The value of the environment variable. If `isSecret` is `true`, this value isn't returned by the API.

isSecret.description: Whether the environment variable is encrypted. Secret values aren't returned by the API.

applyEnvVarsToBuild.description: Whether to inject the environment variables at build time.

buildTag.description: The tag name to apply to a successful build of this version. Can be `null` when the version has no build tag.

tools.name: update_actor
tools.description: Update provided actor fields only: metadata, default run options, source versions, permission level, Store visibility (isPublic), pricing (pricingInfos) and build tags (taggedBuilds). Publishing and paid listings remain subject to Apify Store requirements, seller billing setup and pricing-change rules. Returns complete actor/pricing data; verify effective pricing and publication after updating. https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/act-put

Publication requires a successful tagged build, README, display information, monetization, sample output and required schemas/permissions. additionalProperties.description:
Definition of a single chargeable event for a pay-per-event Actor. Each event is either flat-priced
(`eventPriceUsd` is set) or tier-priced (`eventTieredPricingUsd` is set); the two are mutually exclusive.

eventTitle.description: Human-readable title shown to users in the billing UI.

eventDescription.description: Human-readable description of what triggers this event.

eventPriceUsd.description: Flat price per event in USD. Present only for non-tiered events. Mutually exclusive with `eventTieredPricingUsd`.

eventTieredPricingUsd.description:
Tiered price-per-event pricing for a single charge event, keyed by subscription tier (e.g. `FREE`, `BRONZE`,
`SILVER`, `GOLD`, `PLATINUM`, `DIAMOND`). The actual price applied is resolved from the user's tier.

tieredEventPriceUsd.description: Price per event in USD for this tier.

isPrimaryEvent.description: Whether this event is the Actor's primary chargeable event.

isOneTimeEvent.description: Whether this event can only be charged once per Actor run.

apifyMarginPercentage.description: Apify's share of the revenue generated under this pricing info record, as a fraction between 0 and 1. Set by the Apify platform.

createdAt.description: When this pricing info record has been created

startedAt.description: Since when is this pricing info record effective for a given Actor

unitName.description: Name of the unit that is being charged

pricePerUnitUsd.description:
Price per unit in USD. Mutually exclusive with `tieredPricing` - exactly one of the two is present
on a pricing record.

tieredPricing.description:
Tiered price-per-dataset-item pricing, keyed by subscription tier (e.g. `FREE`, `BRONZE`, `SILVER`, `GOLD`,
`PLATINUM`, `DIAMOND`). The actual price applied to a run is resolved from the user's tier.

tieredPricePerUnitUsd.description: Price per unit in USD for this tier.

apifyMarginPercentage.description: Apify's share of the revenue generated under this pricing info record, as a fraction between 0 and 1. Set by the Apify platform.

createdAt.description: When this pricing info record has been created

startedAt.description: Since when is this pricing info record effective for a given Actor

trialMinutes.description: For how long this Actor can be used for free in trial period

apifyMarginPercentage.description: Apify's share of the revenue generated under this pricing info record, as a fraction between 0 and 1. Set by the Apify platform.

createdAt.description: When this pricing info record has been created

startedAt.description: Since when is this pricing info record effective for a given Actor

pricingInfos.description: Native pricing records from the current public API. Get the existing records with get_actor and preserve platform-managed apifyMarginPercentage and createdAt; never invent a margin or rewrite pricing history. startedAt is the effective timestamp. New monetization uses PAY_PER_EVENT; FREE means no developer charge (platform usage may still be billed). Dataset-item and monthly models are legacy and depend on account/actor eligibility. Complete payout/billing information and accept Store terms in Console before monetizing. Significant price changes can take 14 days and are subject to provider restrictions; inspect returned pricingInfos rather than assuming immediate activation. Custom events must be charged inside actor code with the Apify SDK (Actor.charge/Actor.pushData); synthetic apify-actor-start and apify-default-dataset-item events are charged automatically.

tools.name: build_actor
tools.description: Build a source version into a runnable actor image. Can incur platform usage costs. All build options are query parameters; no request body. Poll get_build and inspect get_log for failures. Tags are applied on success. https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/act-builds-post

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. my-user~my-actor. Write tools require ownership or the corresponding actor permission.

useCache.description: Use the build cache; Apify default is false.

betaPackages.description: Use beta Apify NPM packages; Apify default is false.

tag.description: Tag applied on success, e.g. latest. Defaults to the source version buildTag.

waitForFinish.description: Wait up to 60 seconds for completion; a returned build can still be RUNNING.

tools.name: list_actor_builds
tools.description: List actor builds with offset/limit pagination and native build status data. Default order is ascending start time; use desc=true for newest first.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. my-user~my-actor. Write tools require ownership or the corresponding actor permission.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get complete build details and status. Optional waitForFinish waits up to 60 seconds; keep polling if still transitional. Only SUCCEEDED indicates a usable build.

buildId.description: Build ID returned by build_actor or list_actor_builds.

waitForFinish.description: Wait up to 60 seconds for completion; a returned build can still be RUNNING.

tools.name: abort_build
tools.description: Abort a starting or running actor build. Completed builds are unaffected; returns the native build response.

buildId.description: Build ID returned by build_actor or list_actor_builds.

tools.name: get_log
tools.description: Retrieve the current plain-text logs for an actor build or run without streaming. Use for build errors and runtime diagnostics.

raw.description: Keep ANSI escape codes verbatim when true; default removes them.

tools.description: Validate an input object against the input schema in an actor build without running the actor. An actor without an input schema accepts any object. Native invalid-input errors are returned. https://docs.apify.com/api/v2

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. my-user~my-actor. Write tools require ownership or the corresponding actor permission.

build.description: Build tag or build number; Apify defaults to latest.

input.description: Input JSON sent directly as the validation request body.

tools.name: run_actor
tools.description: Run an Apify actor asynchronously with a JSON input object. The response contains the run ID, status, defaultDatasetId, and defaultKeyValueStoreId. Poll get_run or fetch results from get_dataset_items after the run succeeds. actorId must be an Apify actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. 'apify~web-scraper'.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. 'apify~web-scraper'.

input.description: JSON input passed directly to the actor. Use get_actor_openapi or the actor's Apify Input tab to discover expected fields. Pass {} for actors with no input.

timeout.description: Optional actor run timeout in seconds.

memory.description: Optional memory limit in MB, usually a power of 2 such as 256, 512, 1024, 2048, or 4096.

maxItems.description: Maximum charged dataset items for pay-per-result actors. This is a billing cap, not a guaranteed result limit.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total charge in USD for pay-per-event actors.

restartOnError.description: Restart the actor run automatically if it fails.

build.description: Actor build tag or build number, e.g. 'latest' or '0.1.234'.

waitForFinish.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the async run to finish before returning. Maximum is 60.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of Apify webhook definitions for this run.

tools.description: Run an Apify actor and wait for dataset items in the response. This is the most convenient one-call path for agents when the actor finishes within roughly 5 minutes. For longer jobs, use run_actor then get_run and get_dataset_items.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner/name, e.g. 'apify~web-scraper'.

input.description: JSON input passed directly to the actor. Use get_actor_openapi or the actor's Apify Input tab to discover expected fields. Pass {} for actors with no input.

clean.description: Return only non-empty items and omit hidden fields.

offset.description: Number of result items to skip.

outputFields.description: Comma-separated output names that rename fields positionally.

tools.description: Get metadata for an Apify key-value store.

tools.name: get_key_value_store_record
tools.description: Get a record value from an Apify key-value store. Use defaultKeyValueStoreId from a run and key='OUTPUT' for actors that store final output outside datasets.

disableRedirect.description: When true, return metadata instead of redirecting to large binary values where supported.

tools.name: get_dataset_items
tools.description: Retrieve items from an Apify dataset. Use defaultDatasetId from run_actor/get_run, or use run_actor_sync_get_dataset_items for one-call execution and results.

datasetId.description: Dataset ID or tilde-separated username/dataset name.

clean.description: Return only non-empty items and omit hidden fields.

outputFields.description: Comma-separated output names that rename fields positionally.

attachment.description: Force file download style response for browser clients.

bom.description: Include a byte-order mark for CSV output.
